original_test_intent: Verify the designated rear USB-C receptacle negotiates its intended display alternate mode and drives an approved monitor at the required stable mode with a correct visible image and no Type-C, DRM or display-path errors.
original_method: Bind chassis rear-port label through Type-C/PD controller, mux/retimer and GPU/display engine to a DRM connector; identify cable/adapter and monitor EDID; operator connects under the approved hot-plug or power-state procedure; agent captures untruncated DRM connector, EDID and xrandr provider/output/mode state; operator observes a known visual pattern for stability, artifacts, color and orientation; preserve Type-C/DRM/kernel events and disconnect safely.
manual_activity: An operator connects the approved display fixture to the specified rear Type-C port and observes the known visual pattern; software collection cannot replace this image check.
required_inputs: Exact chassis rear Type-C receptacle and controller/mux/retimer/GPU-to-DRM mapping
Supported DP Alt Mode/USB4/Thunderbolt mode, lane/pin assignment and PD role if applicable
Approved cable/adapter and monitor make/model/EDID plus required resolution/refresh/color mode
Hot-plug or power-state procedure and visual artifact/stability observation rubric
safety_requirements: Verify the physical port and fixture identities before connection
Use the approved hot-plug/power-state sequence and inspect cable/adapter condition
Run only read-only queries; do not change modes or install drivers during evidence collection
Preserve complete output and kernel/Type-C/DRM events rather than clearing/truncating them
Stop on PD fault, unstable signal, repeated reconnect, artifacts, display loss or new DRM errors
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/session/tools and physical-to-logical connector mapping
Collect untruncated DRM status, EDID identity, xrandr providers/outputs/modes and relevant events
Correlate operator photo/observation with the exact connected state
Do not connect hardware, infer visible quality, reconfigure display, clear logs or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve rear-port path, supported alternate mode and test fixture
Approve required display mode and visible-image acceptance rubric
Review software plus operator evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: PARTIAL REAR USB-C DISPLAY-PATH ENUMERATION AND VISUAL OUTPUT TEST
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the physical rear receptacle to the logical connector and combine complete negotiated-path data with a timestamped known-pattern visual observation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controller/path/fixture identity, alternate-mode and EDID evidence, full non-truncated output and a defined visual rubric.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A connected DRM state or advertised mode does not prove the rear port was used or that pixels render correctly and stably.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Headless sessions may make xrandr misleading; adapters can hide EDID/path properties, and only the operator can directly observe visible artifacts.

project_override_considerations: The project must define whether this rear connector uses native DP Alt Mode, USB4/Thunderbolt tunneling or a platform-specific bridge, and the expected connector/EDID/mode mapping for the selected fixture.

Cable/adapter and monitor PN/serial/EDID identity plus connection procedure
Complete timestamped DRM status/EDID and xrandr providers/outputs/modes stdout/stderr
Known-pattern monitor photo/observation with resolution/refresh, stability/artifact/color result
Preserved Type-C/PD/DRM/kernel/SEL events, discrepancy record and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2196 Wistron-HW-00477-V002: approve the exact rear Type-C receptacle-to-PD/controller/mux/retimer/GPU/DRM path, required DP Alt Mode/USB4 behavior and role, cable/adapter/monitor/EDID fixture, resolution/refresh/color acceptance, hot-plug or power-state procedure, known-pattern visual stability/artifact rubric, Type-C/DRM error limits and cleanup.

review_improvement: Prevents connector-name and enumeration-only acceptance by tying the rear physical port to its negotiated path and an actual stable rendered image.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source is specifically rear Type-C, so a generic `connected` entry cannot show the correct receptacle or alternate-mode path. EDID and mode advertisement prove a control channel, not pixel correctness. The automated portion must bind topology and capture complete connector state; the operator supplies the irreducible display observation using a known pattern. Reconfiguration would change what is being measured and is excluded from this functional check.
